decisions.reason: The source separately specifies internal-link destinations for the stuffed dolls blog, but that change is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The request to add images and internal links does not change the existing blog production or publication state; its publication condition already requires those additions.
The source specifies images and link destinations but does not alter selected blog keywords or the keyword replacement rule.
The source concerns additions to an existing stuffed dolls article and does not change the workflow for proposing or selecting blog topics.
The source does not change the campaign keyword count, selected replacement keyword, or mapped page.
Mention of the stuffed dolls blog is unrelated to the existing webpage replacement text requirement.
Internal links within the stuffed dolls blog are distinct from the off-page backlink creation requirement and do not change its count or link-type percentages.
The request to insert blog images does not specify or change ALT attribute optimization for those images.
